name: Logic for Computer Science
description: Logic for specifying systems, propositional logic, proof systems for propositional logic (resolution, DPLL, CDCL, natural deduction), soundness and completeness of propositional logic proof systems, SAT/SMT solvers, predicate logic, proof systems for predicate logic (resolution with unification, natural deduction), soundness and completeness of predicate logic proof systems, compactness, Hoare logic, soundness, relative completeness, alloy/Z3/automated theorem provers.
